title: erdos-85: push for a significant result — monotonicity via witness extension

problemStatement.plain: ## Goal Push `erdos-85` past small-value bookkeeping toward a result that is *significant* — ideally the stated Erdős question itself. Spun out of #43622: surveying our gallery against [VibeMathed's](https://vibemathed.com/) entry criteria showed that almost nothing we hold qualifies, because their bar is "a precisely stated open question whose answer is now a proved or disproved theorem" and they explicitly exclude formalizations of known results. `erdos-85` is our best-positioned recognized op
